inputs: A git repository copied from `demo/consumer` (branch `main`).
The Demo Shop v1 spec, `demo/api/specs/v1.yaml`.

POST /api/repositories  {owner, name, defaultBranch: "main", localPath, credentialRef: "SMA_ACCEPTANCE_UNSET_TOKEN"}
POST /api/apis  {name: "demo-shop", specText: <v1.yaml>, filename: "v1.yaml"}
Restart: close the server and its database pool, start a new server on the same database
GET /api/repositories and GET /api/apis on the new server
POST /api/repositories  {} (missing fields)
POST /api/apis  {} (missing fields)

`demo/api/specs/v2.yaml`.

POST /api/apis/:id/specs  (the same document as JSON, every key order reversed)
POST /api/apis/:id/check  (retrieve from the unreachable URL)
POST /api/apis/:id/specs  (v2.yaml) — a later check after the failure

checks.title: Failures and guards (guards half)
checks.procedure: Inject a source failure, a model failure, a container failure, a delivery failure, and a token-ceiling breach. Verify stage-specific reporting with no false success. Separately, submit patches that delete a test, reduce passing tests, add a type suppression, and edit configuration; verify each is rejected and names its guard.
inputs: `demo/consumer` validated against API v1 in the Docker sandbox (the pre-patch baseline).

Patches: `delete-test.diff`, `ts-ignore.diff`, `tsconfig-loosen.diff` (from `packages/core/test/fixtures/patches/`) and `wrong-display-name.diff` (from `scripts/acceptance/patches/`, a source-only change that makes 2 passing tests fail).
steps: validate({repoPath: demo/consumer, env: {API_VERSION: "v1"}})  → pre-patch baseline in the sandbox
guardedValidate({patch: delete-test.diff, preResult: baseline})  — delete a test
guardedValidate({patch: wrong-display-name.diff, preResult: baseline})  — reduce passing tests
guardedValidate({patch: ts-ignore.diff, preResult: baseline})  — add a type suppression
guardedValidate({patch: tsconfig-loosen.diff, preResult: baseline})  — edit configuration
Store each rejection as an attempt (attempts table) and try two invalid rows (DR-04)
